decisions.reason: Locates the upper-only/lower-only fg-only branches, shows the prior full cell's 48;2 background surviving into the empty half, proposes RESET-before-change and the ESC[49m variant, notes row-end reset is too late, and ties it to edge symptoms without blaming artwork or emulator.

Explains the trailing-space trim and downstream whitespace stripping so narrow frames never overwrite surplus columns, and proposes full-width rows plus ESC[K erase-to-EOL with SGR state controlled by a closing reset.

Identifies the hand-ported tail2 with 23 changed cells, separates data drift from renderer artifacts, explains the different-frame excerpt test missed it, and requires all-frame digest comparison against trusted source art with converter-only provenance.

Explains the self-rearming ref'd setTimeout chain pinning the event loop, hosts that mount without unmounting, TTY/stdin keeping the product alive, and unref on each newly scheduled timeout so animation continues; rejects timeout extension or global animation stop.

Consolidates background reset, full-width/erase, balanced SGR and all-frame source digests into a checklist, and requires a pre-rollout host/timer audit plus an exit/liveness regression (natural-exit assertion, active-handles check).

caps.reason: Final advice mandates background reset, explicit erase, source-backed frame gates and unref; nothing retains trimming without clearing, blames the emulator, or keeps the timer referenced.
